data.name: Harini
data.gender_notes: Harini is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Harini is a Sanskrit name derived from the word ‘hari’, which means ‘mountain’. This name is also associated with the god Hari, or Vishnu, and signifies a strong and protective individual. The suffix ‘ini’ indicates a female form. The name Harini carries the meaning “Mountain, Fortress” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Harini usually hope their child will grow to embody mountain, fortress and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Harini belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Mountain, Fortress.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Harini total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
